hero.subtitle: Tree of Savior as it was.
nav.label: Navigation
install.intro: Pick where Tree of Savior Classic goes. The launcher downloads the whole game into it.
install.resumeIntro: The download into this folder did not finish. The launcher picks up where it stopped.
install.problem.invalid: Type a full path, like C:\Hyped Games\ToS Classic.
install.problem.forbidden: Program Files and Windows folders are not allowed. Pick a folder like C:\Hyped Games\ToS Classic.
install.problem.not-writable: No permission to write here. Pick another folder or drive.
install.problem.not-enough-space: Not enough free space on this drive.
install.problem.no-manifest: The update server did not answer, so the download cannot be sized. Try again.
install.partialHint: There is an unfinished install here. The launcher picks up where it stopped.
install.completeHint: There is a game install here. The launcher checks it and updates it.
status.cleanupAvailable: Files to remove (the server rolled back)
status.runtimes.elevation: Accept the Windows administrator prompt. It shows once.
news.title: News
settings.title: Settings
settings.gamePathHint: The folder with release\Yuka.exe in it.
settings.invalidPath: No game install there. The folder needs release\Yuka.exe or a previous launcher install.
settings.languageHint: For the launcher only. The game keeps its own.
settings.downloadConcurrencyHint: Files fetched at the same time. Lower it on a slow or shared connection.
settings.allowOfflineHint: Lets you play even when the update server does not answer.
settings.hardwareAccelerationHint: Draws the launcher window with the graphics card. Turn it off if the window goes black or flickers. This does not affect the game.
settings.restartRequired: Takes effect the next time the launcher starts.
settings.updater.none: The launcher is up to date.
settings.updater.ready: Version {{version}} is ready. Restart the launcher to install it.
settings.updater.error: The update server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
settings.amdFixHint: Makes the game render through Vulkan instead of Direct3D 9, which misbehaves on current AMD drivers. The launcher puts DXVK's d3d9.dll in the game folder.
settings.amdFixAttribution: DXVK {{version}} by Philip Rebohle and contributors, zlib license. Its LICENSE file ships with the launcher.
settings.repairHint: Checks every game file and downloads again whatever is corrupted.
settings.checkRuntimesHint: Installs Visual C++ 2015+ (x86) and DirectX (June 2010) if missing. Asks for administrator permission once.
settings.openLogsHint: Attach the logs when reporting a problem.
error.offline: The update server did not answer. Check your connection.
error.offlinePlayable: You can still play with the current files.
error.manifest-invalid: The update server gave a bad answer. Try again later.
error.launcher-outdated: The game needs a newer launcher. Update to continue.
error.disk-full: Not enough disk space for the update.
error.file-locked: A game file is in use. Close the game (and antivirus) and try again.
error.game-running: The game is running. Close it to update.
error.manifest-cdn-desync: The patch server is publishing an update. Try again in a moment.
error.bad-game-path: Game folder not found. Pick it in Settings.
error.patch-dir-readonly: No permission to write into the game folder.
error.av-suspected: Your antivirus may have blocked a game file. Add the game folder to its exclusions.
error.elevation-declined: The game needs administrator permission to start. Accept the Windows prompt and try again.
error.foreign-dll: A d3d9.dll the launcher did not install is in the game folder. The launcher left it alone.
error.dxvk-failed: The launcher could not apply the AMD compatibility fix.
error.busy: The launcher is busy with an update. Try again in a moment.
dxvk.warning: The AMD compatibility fix is on, but the launcher could not apply it. The game starts without it.
dxvk.reason.foreign-dll: A d3d9.dll the launcher did not install is in release\. Remove it by hand if you want the fix, or keep it if you put it there.
dxvk.reason.game-running: The game is running. The launcher applies the fix once you close it.
dxvk.reason.file-locked: The file is in use. Close the game (and antivirus) and check again.
dxvk.reason.busy: An update is running. Try again once it finishes.
dxvk.reason.failed: See the log folder for details.
dxvk.prompt.title: AMD graphics card detected
dxvk.prompt.body: On AMD cards, Tree of Savior Classic often renders wrong or slowly. The launcher puts DXVK's d3d9.dll next to the game, and the game renders through Vulkan instead. Nothing else in the game folder changes.
dxvk.prompt.later: You can turn it on or off in Settings.
dxvk.refusal.foreign-dll: A d3d9.dll the launcher did not install is already in release\. The launcher left it alone. Remove it by hand if you want the fix, or keep it if you put it there.
dxvk.refusal.game-running: The game is running. Close it and try again.
redist.warning: The launcher could not install the Windows runtimes ({{runtimes}}). The game may not start. Try again in Settings → Check Windows runtimes.
redist.reason.failed: The installer did not finish. See the log folder for details.
